text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraq and Tunisia discuss trade expansion.
- Russian ultra-nationalist Vladimir Zhirinovsky sends a telegram to President Saddam Hussein congratulating him on his birthday anniversary.
- Iraqi Deputy Prime Minister Tareq Aziz leaves for Beijing.
- King Hussein of Jordan starts visit to Oman.
- Iraqi pharmacists hold their annual conference.
(The above were also carried by JUMHOURIYA and QADISSIYA)
- International firms express readiness to supply Iraq with medicines under the oil-for-food deal with the United Nations.
- State-run shopping centres start distributing foodstuffs to civil servants with prices lower than those of the commercial markets.
